text: This clinic is very expensive, and the medication is also pricey. They even remove the stickers from the medication labels so we don't know what it is, and they don't give us the medication boxes. Considering the price and quality of service, I compared it to other clinics with the same doctor and found the quality was no different. In short, if you're considering this clinic, I recommend going elsewhere. Or, if you do plan to go, bring at least 1,000 baht.
